Record Class PyprojectModel.Build

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.pyronaut.config.model.PyprojectModel.Build
Record Components:
mode - legacy default build mode, derived from PyprojectModel.Packaging.format()
pythonBytecodeEnabled - whether generated Python resources include bytecode caches
nativeBase - local reusable native runtime image path or URL
metadata - native image metadata settings
docker - container image build settings
